activities.name: Tioga Road, Yosemite
activities.note: the high country behind the gate - Tuolumne Meadows and the park's eastern entrance - is unreachable by car while it is shut

windows.reason: snow closes the road for the winter. It shuts around November and most years reopens in late May or June; the Park Service does not commit to a date in advance
the shoulder months the closure and the reopening fall in - the exact day depends on that year's snow
reliably open and clear of snow
snow closes the road and it is not possible to drive to Glacier Point; in winter only the first five miles stay open, to the Badger Pass ski area
the road usually closes for snow at some point in November and reopens in late May or early June

activities.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road over Logan Pass, Glacier
activities.note: the lower sections of the road stay open all year; it is the alpine stretch over Logan Pass that waits on the snowplough

windows.reason: snow shuts the alpine section over Logan Pass; it is typically fully open only from early July to mid-October
ploughing is still under way and there is no set opening date over Logan Pass; it is typically fully open by early July
usually fully open until the third Monday of October, though early snow can close it sooner

activities.name: Yellowstone park roads by car
activities.note: the road from the North Entrance through Mammoth and Lamar Valley to the Northeast Entrance is the one route open to cars all year

windows.reason: most roads close to cars in early November; in winter only guided snowcoach and snowmobile tours travel the interior
roads reopen to cars in stages from mid-April and are typically all open by Memorial Day weekend
Dunraven Pass and the Beartooth Highway close in mid-October, and snow can shut other roads without warning

activities.name: Trail Ridge Road, Rocky Mountain
activities.note: the highest continuous paved road in the US, topping out at 12,183 feet

windows.reason: blowing and drifting snow at high elevation closes the road for the winter; it historically reopens on Memorial Day weekend
the road historically opens on Memorial Day weekend; a late-May snowstorm can push that into June
snow and high winds close it for the season, on average around 23 October

activities.name: Denali Park Road buses
activities.note: outside the bus season the road is snowbound beyond Park Headquarters, and most lodging near the park closes from autumn until mid-May

windows.reason: transit buses start on 20 May, with narrated tour buses about a week earlier
the full summer bus service runs; private cars are limited to the first 15 miles
transit buses stop on the second Thursday after Labor Day; afterwards private cars may drive to Teklanika River (mile 30) until snow closes the road

activities.name: Northern lights, Fairbanks
activities.note: the aurora is there all year, but in the summer the night sky at this latitude is too bright to see it

windows.reason: the aurora season: nights are dark enough to see the lights from late August to late April
the edges of the season, which runs from 21 August to 21 April

activities.name: Humpback whale watching, Hawaii
activities.note: the whales come to Hawaii each winter to breed and calve, and head north to their feeding grounds by summer

windows.reason: peak whale season, when the sanctuary's annual whale count is held
humpbacks can be seen from shore and at sea from November through April
